ayahOccurrences.text: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ ٱلْجِيَادُ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: ٱلْجِيَادُ is in the derivative form: جِيَادٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ج/و/د   j–w–d horses, to seek a horse; generosity, generous person; goodness, excellence, nobility; rain‐laden clouds.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
الجُودِيُّ ʾal‐Jūdiyy and جِيَادٌ jiyād.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
جِيَادٌ jiyād[pl. of n./quasi act. part. جَوَادٌ jawād] horses, chargers; magnificent, the select, well‐bred

(38:31) إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ الصَّافِنَاتُ الْجِيَادُ ... when, at the close of the day, well‐bred light‐footed horses were paraded before him …

entries.label: الجوُدِيُّ
entries.definitionHtml:
الجوُدِيُّ ʾal‐Jūdiyy[proper name] the mountain upon which Noah’s ark settled, traditionally identified with Mount Ararat located in either Armenia or Syria and now said to be in Turkey

(11:44) وَاسْتَوَتْ عَلَى الْجُودِيِّ and it [the Ark] settled on [Mount] Jūdiyy.
